text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's broken away from the pack and
crossed the
finish line! The winner is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Tall is the wall that is the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For an instant, Yaeno's fighting spirit
was as a
dance of flames, flaring up high
enough to
incinerate the very sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The fact she has control over such
intensity is
worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm still such a novice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sob... Sob...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno... Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But only those who fight have the
privilege of
lamenting defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I do not even have that right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, I will shine bright at the
Japanese
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how heavy the price I must
pay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My deepest apologies, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But... but!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm a disgrace!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win... I wanted to claim
victory for
Grampa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I vow to redouble my efforts to help her
achieve
this goal.
choice_data_list: 次の『日本ダービー』で勝とう
choice_data_list_en: Let's win the upcoming Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Next time... Next time, I'll win for
sure...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And prove that the path I've been
following was
not a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, choosing to make use of my
competitive
spirit was definitely the
right choice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As was learning to temper my fierce
blaze with
the stillness of water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue on the path that Grampa
showed
me and prove that I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This I shall do without fail at the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is willing to shed blood,
sweat, and
tears for her ardent dream,
and it is my role as her
trainer to help
her fulfill it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! I'll do my very best!
choice_data_list: ああ！必ず君を導くと約束する！
うん！必ず貴方を導くと約束する！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah! I promise I'll guide you!
Yeah! I promise I'll guide you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki makes her declaration
loudly, with
tears glimmering in her eyes.
